name: Analytic Single Scattering Model for Airlight
definition: An analytic method for computing single scattered radiance (airlight) at a viewer from an isotropic point light source, where both are immersed in a homogeneous scattering medium. It solves the problem of real-time variation of viewpoint, lighting, medium properties, and scene geometry, addressing effects of scattering on surface shading and complex lighting like environment maps.
summary: This model computes real-time single-scattered airlight in homogeneous media by reducing a complex integral to an analytic function using a precomputed 2D lookup table, distinguishing itself by handling both glows and surface shading.
